decisions.reason: Selecting Transak for the fiat on-ramp does not change the independently selected Brevo transactional email provider or email-delivery behavior.
The provider change does not alter email-based dashboard authentication, its magic-link flow, or its intended non-wallet and fiat users.
The fiat on-ramp provider selection does not affect unauthenticated access to public referral statistics.
The source decision concerns only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not change badge selection, icons, or presentation.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not modify the commission or prize-ticket rewards for successful coded referrals.
The Transak selection does not change the random reward issued when a mint has no referral code.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter the ticket counters or permanent badges exposed through NFT metadata.
The source decision does not change prize eligibility, ticket weighting, or the random winner-selection method.
Selecting Transak for fiat purchases does not change the requirement to enforce royalties on secondary sales.
The fiat on-ramp provider selection does not affect the condition for awarding the First Referral badge.
